explanation: ArrayBufferObject now narrows the resizable maximum-length slot to Private and initializes it directly. The first-view slot was also changed to Private storage; a GC can reclaim the view while the buffer retains its pointer, and a later resize dereferences it.
verification: The witness exited successfully on the pre-edit ASan shell. After the requested rebuild, the same command hit a fatal SpiderMonkey assertion and AddressSanitizer SEGV in ResizableArrayBufferObject::notifyViewsAfterResize.
